llm.summary: The skill is not clearly malicious, but its helper can use your Crawlora key for Crawlora API calls beyond Apple job searches.

dimensions.detail: Network access to Crawlora and a CRAWLORA_API_KEY are expected for this integration, but arbitrary authenticated Crawlora endpoint access is broader than needed for Apple job research and may consume quota or invoke unrelated API products.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer, package dependency, background setup, or auto-executing install logic was found; the skill consists of markdown reference files and a curl-based shell helper.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions in SKILL.md are narrowly scoped, while the executable helper has no allowlist for /apple-jobs/search and /apple-jobs/job and can attach the user's API key to broader Crawlora API requests.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, local mutation, or credential storage was found; however the API key is expanded into curl arguments during requests, which is a credential-handling hardening issue on systems where process arguments are visible.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill presents itself as Apple jobs research and documents two Apple Jobs GET endpoints, but scripts/crawlora.sh accepts any path, HTTP method, and JSON body under the Crawlora API base and even includes examples for Amazon, YouTube, Google Search, and Google Trends.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable giving this skill a Crawlora API key and relying on the agent to call only the intended Apple Jobs endpoints. Prefer a Crawlora key with the narrowest available permissions or quota limits, and review commands before execution because the bundled helper can call unrelated Crawlora endpoints.
llm.findings:
[TP4] unexpected: Confirmed in artifact: the declared Apple-jobs scope is narrower than the generic Crawlora helper's arbitrary path, method, and body support.
[LP3] expected: Use of a shell/curl helper is disclosed and coherent for an API wrapper, but missing tool and endpoint restrictions compounds the overbroad helper behavior.
[E1] expected: External requests to https://api.crawlora.net/api/v1 and use of CRAWLORA_API_KEY are clearly disclosed and necessary for the advertised API integration; this is not hidden exfiltration by itself.
[T05] unexpected: Confirmed in artifact: scripts/crawlora.sh does not enforce the two documented Apple Jobs endpoints and can make broader authenticated Crawlora requests.
[T09] expected: The key is sourced from an environment variable rather than hardcoded, but passing it as a curl header argument may expose it locally through process inspection.
